[[File:Pendar.png|alt=Three golden six-pointes stars (one above, two below) on a back of red and white vertical stripes|thumb|Sigil of House Pendar]]
'''House Pendar''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. The High Seat of House Pendar is Lord [[Abelle Pendar]].

==House Sigil==
The sigil of House Pendar consists of three six-pointed golden stars, one above and two below, on a field of seven vertical red and white stripes.{{ref/book|twotc}}

==Activities==
During the Third Succession War, House Pendar supported [[House Trakand]] gaining the throne.

During the Fourth Succession War, House Pendar was initially among the six neutral great Houses that met with the Amyrlin Seat Egwene in Murandy. After the Siege of Caemlyn House Pendar supported [[Elayne Trakand]] due [[Dyelin Taravin]] speech in her favour.{{ref/book|10|13}}
